subject: Emberlyne: request for combined trial credits + discount (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Asha Roy <asha@emberlyne.com>
Cc: Nikhil Shah <n.shah@emberlyne.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Emberlyne POC — combined credits + discount request

Hi Asha,

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Emberlyne's team is ready to start the 6-week POC next week but flagged two blockers on budget and activation velocity:

- They need an extra 150k free token credit on top of our standard trial to cover higher volume evals (embedding + chat).
- They'd like a one-time 15% list-price discount on the initial 3-month commitment if the POC shows signal.

Per our guidelines this is an exception request that requires a senior approval. Can you confirm the business justification below (so I can escalate):
- Expected production start: Jan 2029 if POC passes
- Target monthly run rate at ARR: $35k/mo in first 6 months
- Key success metrics: latency < 150ms 90th, accuracy on prompt set >= 86%

I've attached the usage projection and a proposed SOW. If you confirm, I'll route to Revenue Ops + Marissa for sign-off.

Next steps: please reply with a short confirmation of business case and any procurement constraints (PO timing / legal redlines).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: emberlyne_usage_projection_q4.xlsx, emberlyne_proposed_sow_v2.pdf
From: Asha Roy <asha@emberlyne.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emberlyne POC — combined credits + discount request

Thanks Jasmine — brief confirmation below.

We can confirm the commercial rationale: Emberlyne will run the POC across two product teams (search + assistant) which bumps token usage; the 150k extra credits are to ensure we can stress-test caching and routing policies. If the POC demonstrates the expected gains we will commit to a 3-month paid pilot (>$90k) and intend to expand. Procurement has a 30-day PO window but is flexible for a committed start date.

If you need a one-pager for execs, I can provide a short business case.

Cheers,
Asha
Head of Partnerships | Emberlyne Technologies
asha@emberlyne.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Emberlyne POC — combined credits + discount request (exec approval please)

Hi Marissa / Priyom —

Forwarding the note from Emberlyne. TL;DR: they want an exception — +150k starter credit + 15% on the first 3 months if we get a signed commitment post-POC. They expect to reach >$35k MRR quickly and there is upside via marketplace/channel later.

Why I think we should approve:
- High velocity account (strong product-led contacts), realistic chance to convert to committed spend in Q1 2029
- Technical depth — they will stress our routing and caching so our perf story will be validated
- Deal is contingent on SOW sign and PO within 30 days; legal redlines are minimal per their counsel

Requested ask to execs: one-off approval to provide 150k free token credits (apply to first 60 days) and a 15% promotional discount on list price for months 1–3.

Attached: usage projection (numbers by team), draft SOW, and a short HubSpot summary (link below).

If you want, I can tighten the guardrails (cap on feature usage, one auto-revert to list price after 90 days, and requirement for a signed LOI to trigger the discount). Please reply with any edits to the guardrails and whether you approve.

Cheers,
Jasmine
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Oct 2028 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Emberlyne POC — combined credits + discount request (exec approval please)

Jasmine — thanks for the succinct summary and the guardrail suggestions. I approve this as a one-time exception with the following conditions: 

1) Credits: 150,000 starter token credit applied to their first 60 days of usage; any overage billed at standard consumption rates.
2) Discount: 15% off list for months 1–3 provided we receive a signed LOI within 45 days of POC completion. No retroactive discounts without a signed LOI.
3) Measurement: Engineering will validate latency and accuracy metrics during the POC; if key thresholds are not met the discount is void.
4) Controls: Revenue Ops (Priyom) to create a custom promo code that auto-reverts after 90 days and to cap token throttle if abuse patterns are detected.

Priyom / Marcus — please implement the promo code, add the usage caps in the account config, and add this approval to the deal record (EMB-7591). Jasmine — confirm to Emberlyne and attach LOI template to the HubSpot deal.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercials | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
